name: create_callback
description: Place a callback request in the practice queue. Use priority 'urgent' when a triage transfer could not be completed. Returns status 'created' only when the request now exists in the queue. Returns 'failed' when the queue refused it and 'unverified' when it could not be confirmed. Never tell the caller that someone will call them back unless status is 'created'. The patient reference is supplied by the system with the call; never ask the caller for it.

callback_phone.description: Best number to reach the caller, as they said it

priority.description: urgent for post-operative concerns, normal otherwise
